title: 土耳其语和阿拉伯语仇恨言论检测综合研究
summary: 该研究针对土耳其语和阿拉伯语中的仇恨言论，构建了涵盖五个土耳其语主题和一个阿拉伯语主题的综合数据集，并开发了基于BERT的最先进模型，用于仇恨类别分类、强度预测、目标识别和跨度检测。
summary_en: This study introduces a comprehensive hate speech dataset for Turkish and Arabic, covering five Turkish topics and one Arabic topic, and develops state-of-the-art BERT-based models for hate category classification, intensity prediction, target identification, and span detection.
